project_identity.name: MikiLab PWA
project_identity.tagline: Hand-free Gamified Artisan Bakery Operations & Learning Platform
project_identity.description: Complete redesign blueprint for MikiLab — a mobile-first PWA for artisan bakers by Michele. Features 3D immersive frosted glassmorphism, real lab photography, high-precision dough metrics, AI vision diagnosis, and 3D voice avatars (Miki & Mohamed).
project_identity.archetype: Cinematic Obsidian & Copper Glow 3D Laboratory (Deep Midnight Obsidian + Frosted Crystal Glass + Copper Ember Accent)
project_identity.viewport_bounds: 390px - 430px optimal mobile viewport with fluid scaling to max-w-6xl desktop layout

i18n.rtl_protocol: Use logical Tailwind classes (ms-*, me-*, ps-*, pe-*, start-*, end-*) and dir='rtl' HTML wrapper for Persian alignment.

glassmorphism_3d_engine.recipe: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#121722]/75 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.40)] rounded-2xl relative overflow-hidden

hover_3d_transform.card_tilt: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:rotate-1 hover:border-[#F26419]/50 hover:shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgba(242,100,25,0.22)] transition-all duration-300 ease-out

scale.hero_title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: Keep both avatars in their original photo/style identity.
Wrap avatars in frosted glass halo containers with active audio status rings when speaking.
Ensure consistent 48px / 64px sizing across all header, chat, and lab screens.

spacing_and_layout.mobile_pwa_container: w-full max-w-[430px] mx-auto px-4 pb-24 pt-16 min-h-screen relative

global_header.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-14 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0E14]/80 border-b border-white/10 z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-4
elements: MikiLab Logo emblem with ember glow
Live Digital Clock (hh:mm:ss in JetBrains Mono)
Language Pills (IT, DE, EN, ES, FR, FA) with #F26419 active highlight

bottom_nav.style: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B0E14]/90 border-t border-white/10 z-50 flex items-center justify-around px-2
bottom_nav.active_state: text-[#F26419] bg-[#F26419]/15 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 font-bold flex flex-col items-center text-xs

floating_action_buttons.radio_player: fixed bottom-20 right-4 z-40 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-[#18202E] border border-white/20 text-[#E8A838] flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg hover:scale-110 transition-transform
floating_action_buttons.voice_assistant: fixed bottom-20 left-4 z-40 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F26419] to-[#D94E00] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(242,100,25,0.5)] hover:scale-110 transition-transform

elite_engine_overlay.description: Full-screen 3D laboratory modal containing 4 interactive rooms (Impasti, Forni, Pasticceria, Guida) + live DB doses calculator + radio player.
elite_engine_overlay.modal_style: fixed inset-0 z-60 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0B0E14]/95 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-8 space-y-6

flour_analysis_center.cards: Parameter cards for W (strength), Protein %, Water Absorption %, P/L ratio, Ash, Falling Number.
flour_analysis_center.test_log: AI photo scan test log for flour bags with auto OCR parameter extraction.

page_by_page_architecture.home_hub: Hero banner with Miki & Mohamed avatars, quick status overview, and 5 Bento cards (Laboratorio, Ricette, Farine, Accademia, Community).
page_by_page_architecture.laboratorio_braccio: Default operative screen showing quick commands (Today's Recipes, Failures, Dough SOS), Banco Impasti, Headset mode toggle, and launcher for Elite Engine 4 Rooms.
page_by_page_architecture.ricette: Category recipe grid (Pane, Pizza, Focacce, Viennoiserie, Basi) with real food photos, filter chips, search bar, and batch calculator.
page_by_page_architecture.farine: Flour Analysis Center with parameter dial gauges, W rating curves, and AI scan log.
page_by_page_architecture.accademia: Interactive lessons, flour quizzes, encyclopedia, news feed, and challenges.
page_by_page_architecture.community: Bakers social feed, infornate photos, leaderboards, and interactive map.
page_by_page_architecture.diagnosi_and_maestro: AI vision camera diagnosis for dough defects and real-time audio/text chat with Maestro AI.

framer_motion_presets.stagger_container: { hidden: { opacity: 0 }, show: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.08 } } }
framer_motion_presets.card_fade_up: { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 18 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 260, damping: 20 } } }

accessibility_and_rtl.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, cards, links, tabs, inputs MUST have data-testid in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='bracciolab-quick-sos').
accessibility_and_rtl.contrast_wcag: All body text must achieve minimum 4.5:1 contrast against dark background. Use #F7F9FC or #94A3B8.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply this dark obsidian 3D glassmorphism theme across all MikiLab components.
Never break existing state or i18n logic.
Ensure Miki (/michele-avatar.jpg) and Mohamed (/mohammed-avatar.jpg) remain visually aligned in their brand roles.
Ensure all buttons have explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid standard flat designs; embrace frosted glass layer depth and glow accents.
Ensure layout is mobile-first (390px-430px) with responsive desktop grid scaling.
Keep full functionality intact while elevating visual quality.
